title: Degraded order create: inventory-service latency tracked memory usage (Oct 2025)
symptoms: process memory usage climbing for tens of minutes
elevated p95 latency on the alerting service
increase in 5xx responses seen by callers
observed_signals: memory_usage rose smoothly over a long period rather than in a single jump
GC pause time and heap-used warnings increased with memory
after a restart, memory dropped and then began climbing again

timeline.event: memory_usage on inventory-service began a near-linear climb
p95 latency on inventory-service moved with memory
restart or rollback dropped RSS; latency followed

contributing_factors: a library upgrade retained event listeners
no SLO existed on RSS slope
resolution: rolled back the library version that retained listeners
captured a heap dump before the second restart
added a slow memory-growth monitor (15-minute slope)
lessons_learned: heap dumps need to be taken before the second crash
a restart that restores latency is mitigation, not a fix
